# MathLive browser assets

Bundled from `mathlive` version `0.111.1` (MIT license) for IRON MIND's offline equation editor.

- `mathlive.min.js` provides the visual math field and static equation components.
- `mathlive-fonts.css`, `mathlive-static.css`, and `fonts/` provide local math rendering assets.
- The app sets the font directory to this folder and disables optional sound downloads.
- `LICENSE.txt` contains the upstream license.

Upstream project: https://github.com/arnog/mathlive
